-- Fixture preparation ONLY in the disposable native-test database; no production SQL.
-- Bind $1 UUID fixture user, $2 unique ASCII email under example.test,
-- $3 encoded IdentityV3 fixture-password hash, $4 random security stamp, $5 random concurrency stamp.
-- Execute both statements in the driver's existing fixture transaction; require one row each.
insert into identity.users
 (id,user_name,normalized_user_name,email,normalized_email,email_confirmed,password_hash,
  security_stamp,concurrency_stamp,phone_number_confirmed,two_factor_enabled,lockout_enabled,
  access_failed_count,lockout_end,status,created_at,temporary_password_expires_at,preferred_locale,locale_version)
values ($1,$2,upper($2),$2,upper($2),true,$3,$4,$5,false,false,true,0,null,
 'PendingEligibility',now(),null,'en-US',0);
insert into identity.user_roles(user_id,role_id)
 select $1,id from identity.roles where name='participant';
